seo.meta_description: Compare ActiveCampaign and MailerLite: pricing, automation, CRM, ease of use, deliverability, and best use cases to pick the right email marketing tool for your

hero.headline: ActiveCampaign vs MailerLite
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Best for growing teams that need powerful, conditional automations and a built-in CRM to manage sales and email in one place.
summary.best_for_b: Best for solo creators, small businesses, and budget-conscious teams that want a fast, easy-to-use email platform with a generous free tier.
summary.quick_take: ActiveCampaign wins when your priority is sophisticated automation, deep segmentation, and a native CRM — ideal for businesses that want to automate multi-step customer journeys and track sales activity. MailerLite is the lean, cost-effective alternative: simpler automations, a friendlier interface, and a free plan that gets small lists up and running quickly. Choose ActiveCampaign for advanced marketing operations; choose MailerLite for affordability and speed to value.

rows.tool_b: Lower-cost tiers and a free plan for small lists make it attractive for budget-conscious users.

paragraphs: Comparing ActiveCampaign and MailerLite comes down to depth versus simplicity. ActiveCampaign pairs email marketing with a built-in CRM and a sophisticated automation engine, while MailerLite focuses on a clean, affordable email experience with straightforward automation and landing pages.

This comparison highlights the core differences — pricing, ease of use, automation capabilities, CRM and sales features, deliverability, and integrations — so you can pick the tool that fits your growth stage and budget.

data.headline: Feature-rich automation vs. simple, budget-friendly email
data.summary: ActiveCampaign is the better choice if you need advanced automations, CRM functionality, and granular segmentation. MailerLite is the smarter pick for small teams and creators who want an affordable, easy-to-use email tool with solid deliverability and essential automation features.

items.question: Which tool is better for small businesses on a tight budget?
items.answer: MailerLite is generally better for tight budgets thanks to its free plan and lower-cost tiers, while ActiveCampaign offers more advanced features at a higher price point.

items.question: Do either platforms include a CRM?
items.answer: ActiveCampaign includes a native CRM and sales automation; MailerLite does not have a built-in CRM and relies on integrations for sales workflows.

items.question: Can I migrate my list and automations from one to the other?
items.answer: Subscriber lists and basic campaign archives are portable via CSV exports, but complex automations and CRM data will require manual rebuilding or third-party migration tools.

items.question: Which platform has better automation capabilities?
items.answer: ActiveCampaign offers more advanced automation features like conditional logic, event triggers, and multi-step branching compared with MailerLite.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: MailerLite offers a free plan with limited features and contacts; ActiveCampaign does not offer a comparable free tier but provides trials and tiered plans.

items.question: Which integrates better with ecommerce platforms like Shopify?
items.answer: Both integrate with Shopify via native connectors or third-party services, but ActiveCampaign's deeper automation and CRM tracking can provide more advanced ecommerce workflows.
